+-- Relacje węzłów w zaakceptowanym wycinku Kraków, bez ponownego ingest.
+WITH road_window AS (
+  SELECT * FROM accepted_roads
+  WHERE region_code = 'PL-12' AND release_id = '2026.11'
+    AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-11-09'
+), node_window AS (
+  SELECT * FROM accepted_junctions
+  WHERE region_code = 'PL-12' AND release_id = '2026.11'
+    AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-11-09'

+SELECT r.road_id, r.from_node, r.to_node

+LEFT JOIN node_window t ON t.node_id = r.to_node
+WHERE r.geometry IS NULL OR f.node_id IS NULL OR t.node_id IS NULL;
